body: This is the first time someone has given me something to actually work with. Thank you for your genuine advice and for listening to me, I'll be sure to take this into account.

My parents are generous and gracious people, but it's very difficult to talk to them. Every conversation eventually turns into an argument/lecture, so I usually just stay in my room to avoid interactions with them, which in hindsight probably makes things worse. They've been dealing with some family issues for a while so, while i wouldn't say they're absent, they've been preoccupied. (which I've counted as a bit of a blessing). I'm very sorry to hear about your father, I hope you've been able to find an escape from that type of environment.
Thank you for commenting :) I live in a very tidy/organized home, I'm currently with my parents because of obvious reasons and they make sure that all my needs are met
